paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range $74\mbox{--}110\,μ\mathrm{eV}/c^2$ with a Cryogenic Millimeter-Wave Receiver
notes: DOSUE-RR cryogenic mm-wave receiver search for dark photon dark matter via metal-plate conversion, 18-26.5 GHz (74-110 ueV). Paper states chi < (0.3-2.0)e-10 at 95% CL over the full mass range; the detailed frequency-dependent limit is only shown in Fig. 5 (no table). Emitted a conservative flat envelope at the weakest value chi = 2.0e-10 across the validity range; the best limit reaches 3e-11 at some masses. DM density assumed 0.39 GeV/cm^3 (Catena & Ullio). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
